facts.text: I asked how the story should continue.
I asked how the story should continue from the current point onwards.
I asked what would be needed to write a next chapter with the same characters.
I said the setting for the next chapter is the three of them back at Elena's and C's place.
C is preparing a spicy tea for all three characters.
Elena and Alex are lying on a big bed.
They have a vaping pen that they are passing around.
All three characters are somewhat exhausted.
C is trying to keep everything up while not letting the others know.
C stays focused on caring for them.
I requested a warm tone, especially between Elena and C.
Alex starts slipping back into darker states of mind.
C tries to counteract Alex's darker states of mind.
I requested that the chapter include inner dialogue.
I asked if I could set a word minimum for the answers.
I set the word minimum to 750.
I asked to rewrite the previous story and write it in a style that resembles a part of a big novel.

events.text: I set a word minimum for the answers to 750.
